sections.name: EmbeddingEngine
sections.title: Shared model loader and embedding functions
sections.what: Loads the embedding model the first time the engine is created and reuses that same instance afterward. It turns a list of texts or one query into normalized numeric vectors.
sections.why: Likely reason: loading the model is slow, so it is done once and shared. Reason for the local-first loading is not stated beyond the fallback log message.
sections.watch_out: If loading fails, the instance has already been saved, so later calls skip loading and fail when they try to use the missing model.

summary: Turns text into lists of numbers, called embeddings, using a small local AI model so that texts with similar meaning can be matched by search.
purpose: Provides the vector step that document search needs, without calling an outside service.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond a description that the model is local.
how: First it loads the BAAI bge-small English model once and reuses it for every request. It tries the local cache first and, if that fails, tries to download the model. For a list of texts it replaces blank entries with a space and returns normalized vectors of 384 numbers. For a single query it does the same for one text.
inputs: Text strings, either as a list or a single query.
outputs: A list of 384-number vectors for each text, scaled so they can be compared directly.
risks: Blank text is replaced by a single space, so empty input still produces a vector that can match unrelated items. If the cache is missing and the network is blocked, model loading fails.
debug: If startup warnings say local loading failed, check that the model is in the cache folder and that the network works. If search results look random, confirm the same model is used for indexing and searching. Check that the returned vectors have 384 numbers.
